item.title: Sidney Crosby to miss at least four weeks for Penguins due to lower-body injury suffered at the Olympics
item.description: The Pittsburgh Penguins are set to be without Sidney Crosby for the next four weeks. item.description: The Washington Capitals have placed forward Sonny Milano on NHL waivers on Wednesday. item.title: Caps beat Flyers 3-1 in return from Olympic break
item.description: Descend with us back into the boy aquarium. After 19 days off, the Washington Capitals slowly came to life in a home game against the Philadelphia Flyers. After a scoreless first period – except there was a score, it was just 0-0 – Hendrix Lapierre fed Rasmus Sandin to give the Caps a well-earned lead.
